Title: Tanay's Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Neeta - 40 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Tanay stands in the park. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay catches the ball.]

Tanay (softly): "Exactly right."

[Tanay kicks the football hard.]

Tanay: "Really?"

[Tanay plays cricket in the park.]

Tanay: "How beautiful!"

[Tanay plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Tanay (happily): "Hey, look at that!"

[Tanay plays with his dog.]

Tanay: "Hey, look at that!"

[Tanay feeds the birds.]

Tanay: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

[Tanay stands in the snow. Neeta stands near him.]

Tanay: "So, here we are!"

[Snow starts to fall.]

Tanay: "What next?"

[Tanay makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Tanay: "I'm ready!"

[Tanay builds a snowman.]

Tanay: "Hmm, I see."

[Tanay catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Tanay (happily): "Mom, listen!"

[Tanay slides down the snowy slope.]

Neeta: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
